cfd_model: single-bucket focused jet, 240mm circular inlet, kOmegaSST, 500 iter
note: Spearman correlation is rank-based and scale-invariant; absolute pressure values unreliable (all-Neumann tendency), wss physically bounded
physical_interpretation: In the jet direct-impact footprint, CFD wall-shear-stress spatial rank is positively correlated with Mansouri erosion rate spatial rank (rho=0.691), consistent with both models predicting higher impact intensity in the concave bucket cup. Outside the impact footprint, correlation drops to near-zero because Mansouri assumes uniform impingement (all 21 buckets uniformly wetted) while CFD correctly shows only 1 bucket intercepting the jet at any instant.
